title: Chinese basics
about: The most common words of written and spoken Mandarin (wordfreq counts; Chinese words don't change form, so nothing needs grouping), most common first, 50 to a unit. Names of people and places are left out. Each word has its pinyin and a short English meaning, and one short everyday sentence in simplified characters that uses it the way native speakers do, with its English translation; ⟦ ⟧ marks the part that translates the word.
